text.en_US:
\s[0]Shoot the switch to initiate a PVP battle. At this time, teams are formed from among all players currently standing on the \c[3]dance floor\c[0].

Players in the same party will be placed on the same team. Players in different parties will be opponents. Each unique party of players present on the dance floor will become its own team.

The player who shot the switch will be prompted for the number of rounds, and then the battle will begin.
